fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Casts 3 barbed lines at once in a spread, each dealing 3 water damage.

fusions.name: Play the Line
fusions.desc: A reeling strike that deals 7 water damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and makes it move 30% slower for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Wriggle Off
fusions.desc: Slips you 4 tiles forward, and you move 25% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: First Nibble
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, a baited barb flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 water damage. Once every 5 seconds.
